job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame like a talking-head video recorded at home in the evening. A strong calm Russian man about 45 with short dark hair greying at the temples, light stubble, kind but tough brown eyes, wearing a fitted black polo shirt and a black sports watch, hands loosely clasped in front of him. He stands in a cozy dim living room, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, sincere serious expression, NO smile. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background softly blurred: a big monstera plant, wooden shelves with a vinyl player, warm amber lamp light and a dark wall. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
